confidence_notes: I ran five of the six allowed searches (one RBA FX lookup, four for Tampa prices). Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated cost-of-living indexes, mainly Numbeo-derived figures cited by Expatica for June 2026, plus Expatistan, WhereandWhen and MyLifeElsewhere. Those indexes put an inexpensive meal at about $15-20, a 0.5L draft beer at about $6-7, a cappuccino at about $4.80-5.80, and a mid-range dinner for two at about $60-80. Cocktail is based on a 2023 Tampa study (about $14) and a crowdsourced downtown-club estimate (about $12), and I nudged it for inflation. The searches found no direct Tampa glass-of-wine average, so wine_glass is an estimate set relative to the cocktail and draft beer prices, using typical US restaurant pricing; it is the least certain food and drink anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of the Tampa market. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any booking pages or listings. Tampa has few registered hostels, so both hostel anchors are especially uncertain. Hotel prices also vary a lot with season and events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other mid-to-large Florida and Sun Belt tourism and business cities (e.g., Orlando, Jacksonville, Charlotte), with prices slightly above the US small-city average. Hotel prices are in line with Orlando and Miami's cheaper submarkets.
